title: Mexican Broccoli Grilled Corn
description: A yeasty, crunchy, indulgent dish combining the flavors of Mexico with the nutrition of Chinese broccoli. This vegan-friendly twist on elote features a crispy corn crust topped with a tangy beurre-monte.
instructions: Grill corn on the cob for 10 minutes, turning occasionally.
In a bowl, mix together corn masa flour, oat flour, nutritional yeast, salt, and black pepper.
Add water to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Divide the dough into 2 equal pieces and shape each into a ball.
Roll out each ball of dough into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Place a grilled corn on the cob in the center of each dough circle and fold the dough over the corn to form a half-moon shape.
Press the edges of the dough together to seal the corn inside.
Brush the tops of the corn with vegan butter and sprinkle with Beurre-Monte.
Grill the corn for an additional 5 minutes, or until the dough is crispy and golden brown.
Allow the corn to cool for a few minutes before serving.
Beurre-Monte: In a small bowl, whisk together 1/4 cup vegan mayonnaise, 2 tablespoons lemon juice, and 1 tablespoon apple cider vinegar until smooth.
